language.label: Interface language
language.hint: The language of NVS's own menus and labels. It doesn't change your writing or the AI's output — those follow your project's language and what you ask for.

showMood.label: Show mood tags
showMood.hint: Delivery cues — the (parenthetical) after a speaker, for visual-novel-style writing. Off hides them in the Write view; your prose keeps them and the Source view still shows them.

showTiming.label: Show timing tags
showTiming.hint: Start → end timecodes on a beat ([00:01:23 → 00:01:27]), for subtitle / transcript work. Off hides the chip in the Write view; your prose keeps the timecodes and the Source view still shows them.

features.label: AI features
features.hint: The generative-AI layer: the assistant (chat + background Tasks), the prompt library, /agent and AI-write while editing, custody AI-suggest, and running analysis (Update / Jobs). Off hides all of it for a deterministic, AI-free workspace — your writing and already-computed result panels (cast, threads, coherence) stay. Turn back on any time; nothing is deleted.

editSource.label: Edit source directly
editSource.hint: Makes the Source view editable — you type raw Markdown and it's saved to the file verbatim, including the frontmatter (so you can change fields the form locks, like a page's id). Only turn this on if you know the format: a broken frontmatter or malformed beat is written as-is and can break analysis. The Write/Preview views stay the safe way to edit.

storage.openToManage: Open a project to manage its storage.
storage.canClean: About {{bytes}} of reset backups and logs can be cleared, and version history compressed — with nothing you’d miss. Your writing, chat, and current analysis are untouched.
storage.tidy: Nothing to clean up — this project is already tidy. Your writing and analysis aren’t counted here.

updates.hint: NVS doesn’t update itself. Check here, and download the new version if one’s available.
updates.failed: Couldn’t check right now — try again later.
